from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCostRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of the total operating cost extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the report")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned, e.g., 2024 Q1")
    total_operating_cost: float | None = Field(description="The specific Total Operating Cost value reported for the period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cost_records: list[CompanyCostRecord]
